entries.test: Anthropic’s April–June 2026 release policies and contemporaneous company spending policies would show whether Mythos became available as unrestricted token spending ended and companies began imposing AI token budgets.
entries.note: The timing asserts coincidence, not causation; “too dangerous” describes Anthropic’s treatment of the model.

entries.test: Anthropic’s Mythos release documentation, safety documentation, and public availability as of June 9, 2026 would establish whether it added guardrails and released the model.
entries.note: “Pushed it out the door” plainly means released it.

entries.test: Anthropic’s historical public statements and new-model launch materials would establish whether it previously disavowed frontier-model work on safety grounds and subsequently launched a frontier model positioned to compete across benchmarks.
entries.note: The proposition shifts “hellbent” from Anthropic to the model and omits the assertion about the pause option. The historical statements and launch positioning have a publicly testable reading.
The metaphors express an accusation of manipulation and credulity without specifying a distinct factual test.
